description:
Use this when the user wants to remove a draft post: "scrap that draft". Moves it to Deleted posts in the
planner, where the user can restore it for 30 days. Touches nothing on a social network and never deletes clips.
Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused) or editing a draft (update_draft). Free.

post_id.description: Id of the draft post, from get_post_stats with status "draft".

name: delete_draft
title: Delete a draft
